name: charter-ts
description: charter-ts, the command of charter: contract-first APIs on Cloudflare Workers, in TypeScript or Go, and the repos that hold them. In a project (its charter.config.ts): dev, check, spec, sdk, deploy, live-test. In any repo: issues, docs, ci, upstream, repo, adopt, new. A repo's npm scripts run them, each the command of its name. A TypeScript Worker imports charter-lib (ts/lib), from the same release: npm i -D https://github.com/joeblew999/charter/releases/download/ts-vX.Y.Z/charter-ts-X.Y.Z.tgz

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: tsc && node --test src/*.test.ts && npm run build
